item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
Textlore 1.1.1: smoother first run and many small fixes

A free update with fixes from our first-time-user test.

First run

  • "Show me my story" now opens Your Lore and plays your story, then points you to Recs and Promises.
  • A Mac with no Messages history now says how to get it (sign in to Messages and switch on Messages in iCloud), and you can start with WhatsApp for Mac alone.
  • The setup screen is tidier, and its picture no longer shows another app switched on.

Around the app

  • One-time tips sit next to what they describe and never cover a page.
  • The sidebar's trial note, trial pill and Settings always fit the window.
  • The Years list shows each chat's last message from that year, and the date filter says the year.
  • Day headings stay pinned at the top of a conversation as you scroll.
  • SMS chats are labelled SMS, and the Recs count says "to try".
  • Search suggestions count the right messages, keep the season in "during:summer 2024", and "Did you mean" picks the word you meant.
  • Ask AI keeps straight who said what, and answers about recs and promises link to those pages with their messages.
  • Export shows only the options each format uses, fits the window, and Save panels open on the Textlore window.
  • The share studio's 16:9 card fits the window.
  • New File and Edit menu items for Export, Jump to Date, Find Next and Select.
  • Reduce Motion takes effect at once, and VoiceOver reads more controls clearly.
  • The licence sheet takes a key from a link even when it is already open, and helps you find your key if it does not match.

Everything stays on your Mac, and Textlore only reads.
